cohort: 300 patients who had undergone Lower Segment Cesarean Section (LSCS) at a tertiary care center in the Bundelkhand region.
finding: 32% of patients experienced postoperative complications, with surgical site infection being the most common (12%), and emergency LSCS and anemia were significantly associated with higher morbidity.
mod_finding: Emergency Lower Segment Cesarean Section (LSCS) was significantly associated with higher postoperative morbidity.
